verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.helix-db.com that describes the product. Doc pages are served as raw .md URLs. On the GitHub side, `helix chef` installs HelixDB query skills and a docs MCP for agent setup, and the CLI docs confirm it automates agent setup without a Cloud login. Missing for 10: independent hands-on reports of agents successfully consuming these docs, and detail on what the docs MCP exposes.
